title: Contents Packout & Storage — Lines the Carrier Declined and the Contested Amount
content:
Lines the carrier declined on the contents coverage stay with the customer where the arrangement bills them. For the customer's share on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job of Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout: **the share carries the carrier denied line write-offs recorded on the contents coverage less the contested amount, never below zero; the contested amount is the amount the most recent contents-coverage price variance supplement request asks for when the arrangement bills denied lines to the customer and that request is named by no carrier approval, it is nothing when the arrangement bills denied lines to the customer and no such request awaits a decision, and in every other case it is the whole of those write-offs.**

The most recent price variance supplement request is the one on the contents coverage carrying the highest supplement number on the file.

## Records read on the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file

- Whether the file's billing arrangement bills denied lines to the customer.
- The receivable write-offs on the contents coverage with reason carrier denied line.
- The price variance supplement requests on the contents coverage, by supplement number, the amount the most recent asks for, and whether a carrier approval names it.

## Decision table

| Arrangement bills denied lines to the customer | Most recent price variance supplement request | Contested amount | The share carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | named by no carrier approval | the amount that request asks for | write-offs less that amount, never below zero |
| yes | none awaiting a decision | nothing | the whole of the write-offs |
| no, or no linked claim file | any | the whole of the write-offs | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- Denied line write-offs 640.00, arrangement bills denied lines, an undecided price variance request asking 250.00: the share carries 390.00.
- Same, the request asking 800.00: 640.00 less 800.00 is negative, so nothing.
- Same write-offs, no undecided request: 640.00.
- Arrangement does not bill denied lines: nothing.
